entities.name: Parnavaz II of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Parnavaz II of Iberia, king of the Artaxiad dynasty, ruled from 63 to 30 BC, playing a pivotal role in the ancient world's geopolitics.


As a member of the powerful Artaxiad dynasty, Parnavaz II worked to maintain Iberia's strategic position in the region, navigating the complex web of alliances and rivalries with neighboring kingdoms.


His reign was marked by significant cultural and economic achievements, including the establishment of trade routes and the promotion of arts and literature.


Parnavaz II's legacy extends beyond his own kingdom, as his diplomatic efforts and military campaigns had far-reaching consequences for the ancient world.


"We must always be mindful of the intricate balance of power in the region, lest we fall prey to the whims of our enemies," Parnavaz II said in a speech to the Iberian nobility, as quoted in the works of the ancient historian Strabo.
